human_anchor_candidate_section.authors: Agadjanian and colleagues, including Brendan Nyhan
human_anchor_candidate_section.design_summary: The 2018 MTurk experiment enrolled3008 participants in five arms. Its direct platform contrast used website and Facebook previews of the same two news articles. The primary credibility outcome averaged accuracy, credibility and trustworthiness on1-4 scales.
human_anchor_candidate_section.project_fit_inference: A candidate for a separate human-benchmark study of presentation effects. Current E02 support/thermometer measures and text-only wrappers are not equivalent to its credibility instrument and image previews; existing results cannot be called a replication.
remaining_requirements: Verify replication files and their reuse terms; inspect exact stimuli and questionnaire.
Freeze a separate aligned outcome, presentation modality, sample and analysis before execution.
Require independent methods review and preserve current study protocols/results.
Disclose selection after current model results and possible model exposure to the published benchmark.
human_anchor_candidate_section.source_observation: Author-hosted paper read via web tool, including Methods, Measures and Appendix references. Publisher returned403; OSF inaccessible through the tool; neither bypassed. No publisher/participant data copied into Git.
human_anchor_candidate_section.title: A Platform Penalty for News? How Social Media Context Can Alter Information Credibility Online

scope: Read only; checkpoint/audit/protocols not edited. Checkpoint overall may be updated by lead independently; this is the human-candidate section used for this report.
